opening.title: Reading the session
opening.body: Its thread shows as soon as the instance answered.

noSession.title: The project keeps no session of that name

nowhere.title: This address leads to no screen
nowhere.body: The link may be old, or the screen does not exist yet.

home.title: What do we test?
home.requestLabel: Tell the agents what to test
home.requestPlaceholder: A rule, a ticket, a screen, a journey…
home.emptyBody: The first one will show here as soon as a request is made.

session.reconnecting: connection to the stream lost, trying again…

cartographer.name: Cartographer
cartographer.role: lists the sources and sorts them by domain

planner.name: Planner
planner.role: explores the application and proposes the plan

writer.name: Writer
writer.role: writes and runs the Playwright tests

plan_reviewer.name: Plan reviewer
plan_reviewer.role: looks for duplicates of the existing tests

coherence_reviewer.name: Coherence reviewer
coherence_reviewer.role: compares each test with its scenario

code_reviewer.name: Code reviewer
code_reviewer.role: judges the quality of the Playwright code

harness.name: Harness
harness.role: accepts on evidence, refuses the rest

thread.label: Thread of the session

queued.title: The session waits for an agent to take it
queued.body: The thread fills as soon as it starts; a message sent until then is delivered to its agents.

live.title: The agents have written nothing yet
live.body: The thread fills with their first event.

ended.title: This session left no event
ended.body: It stopped before its agents started.

thread.lookFile: {{title}} — see the file of the test

plan.refusalsLabel: Refusals of the harness before the plan was accepted
plan.refusalsTitle: Refused by the harness before the plan was accepted

scope.note: Only these levels are designed; design.levels in oqas.json sets them.

going.asks: Tell the agents what to correct
going.placeholder: Tell the agents what to correct…

ended.asks: Tell the agents what to do next: correct a test, add a scenario…
ended.placeholder: Tell the agents what to do next: correct a test, add a scenario…

stop.title: Stop this session?
stop.note: Its agents stop as soon as they hand over, and the session does not resume. What they wrote stays in the test repository.

steps.interrupted: The session stopped without going to its end.

tools.listOperations: Listed the operations of the API of {{source}}
tools.submitIndex_one: Handed in an index of {{count}} domain
tools.submitIndex_other: Handed in an index of {{count}} domains

problems.unknown_session: The project keeps no session of that name.
problems.invalid_request: The request is not valid: tell the agents what to test.
problems.session_running: The session is running again: send it your message as to a session at work.
problems.session_ended: The session just ended: there is nothing left to stop, and your message, sent again, goes on with it.
problems.unavailable: No source of sessions is configured on this instance.
problems.not_opened: The session could not be opened.
problems.opening_timed_out: Opening the session took too long: try again in a moment.
problems.stale_revision: The configuration changed since you opened it: read it again, then make your change again.
problems.configuration_conflict: oqas.json changed since the last synchronisation: keep the file, or keep your changes.
problems.invalid_configuration: The configuration is not valid: correct the fields it points out.
problems.no_configuration: The instance has no configuration yet.
problems.unknown_document_source: The configuration in force declares no such source of uploaded documents: save the configuration first.
problems.unknown_document: The source no longer holds this document.
problems.invalid_documents: The documents are refused, and none was kept: correct the files pointed out.
problems.unknown_trace: This run of the test kept no trace.
problems.unknown_capture: This run of the test attached no capture for this step.
problems.unknown_execution: The instance no longer keeps this execution.
problems.launch_refused: The tests cannot be launched now: a session or another launch is running, or the environment asked for is not declared.
problems.unknown_campaign: The instance does not keep this campaign.
problems.campaign_refused: The campaign refuses this change: its state does not allow it, a test it names is not in the repository, or no test is chosen yet.
problems.unexplained: The instance ran into an error.
problems.unreadable: The answer of the instance cannot be read.
problems.unknown_secret: The configuration saved does not name this variable: save the configuration that names it first.
problems.secret_refused: This value cannot be saved: it is empty, or the environment of the tool sets the variable already, and wins.

rules.too-few-keys: Fill in one value at least.
rules.env-var-name: Name of an environment variable expected: capitals, digits and underscores, never the value.
rules.slug: Lower case letters and digits, separated by hyphens.
rules.ui-url-required: A web application needs the address of its interface.
rules.url-absolute: Absolute address expected, such as https://example.test.
rules.url-credentials: An address holds neither a user name nor a password.
rules.unknown-reference: Nothing of that name is declared.
rules.api-without-environment: An API is named within an environment.
rules.path-absolute: Path relative to the root of the test repository expected.
rules.path-outside-root: The path leaves the test repository.
rules.format-version: Format version not supported: 1 is expected.
rules.json: The file is not valid JSON.
rules.openapi-source: Either an address, or a file of the repository: exactly one.
rules.document-source: Either a path, or uploaded documents: exactly one.
rules.logs-source: Either a log file, or a container and its engine.
rules.container-name: Name of a container expected: letters, digits, underscores, dots and hyphens.
rules.document-name: File name not taken: no leading dot, no slash and no control character, 200 characters at most.
rules.document-format: Only Markdown is read: a file ending with .md or .markdown.
rules.document-size: Too large: a document holds 1 MB at most.

cross-application.label: Cross-application
cross-application.hint: an action and its effect in another application

end-to-end.label: End to end
end-to-end.hint: a journey through three applications or more

autonomy.title: Autonomy
autonomy.hint: how far the agents go on their own
autonomy.guardrail: Guardrail of a run, in minutes
autonomy.guardrailHint: Beyond it, the tasks of the agents stop.
autonomy.maxIterations: Calls to the model per task

design.title: Design levels
design.hint: from the base of the pyramid to its top
design.legend: Levels of tests asked of a plan

languages.title: Languages
languages.hint: what the product says, and what the tests say
languages.language: Language of the console and of the agents
languages.languageHint: The console, the conversation of the terminal and what the agents say to you.
languages.testLanguageHint: The titles, the steps and the intents of the tests written; their code stays in English.

repository.title: Layout of the repository
repository.hint: each folder relative to the root of the test repository

model.title: Model
model.githubNote: The tool uses the GitHub account signed in on the machine it runs on, with its Copilot subscription: nothing to type. On a shared machine, everyone goes through this account.
model.baseUrlHint: That of its OpenAI-compatible API, such as that of a model run on your machine.
model.apiKeyEnvHint: The name the key is kept under; that of the provider will do. Leave it empty for a server with no key.
model.failed: The test could not be made: {{reason}}
model.pickBelow: Choose a model in the list.
model.noList: The server does not list its models: type the name of the model.
model.signedOut: No GitHub account is signed in on this machine. Run this command in a terminal, then test again:
model.noModels: The GitHub account {{account}} is signed in, but Copilot offers it no model: the account needs a GitHub Copilot subscription, or its organisation must allow one.
model.keyMissing: {{variable}} holds no key here: type it above, then test again.
model.keyRefused: The provider refused the key (status {{status}}). Check the key the variable holds.
model.unreachable: Nothing answers at {{url}}. Check the address, or that the server is running.
model.modelHint: Its name, as the server gives it, such as gpt-4.1.
model.reasoningEffortHint: A word of the server, such as low or high; nothing is sent without one.
model.timeout: Wait for an answer, in seconds
model.visionTold: the list says this model reads images

secret.kept: Kept on the computer the tool runs on, out of the test repository and of the database, in {{variable}}; it is not shown again.
secret.saved: A value is saved for {{variable}} on this computer; type another to replace it.
secret.environment: comes from the variable {{variable}} of the environment of the tool, which wins over a value typed here.

explorations.read-write: Read and write: may create or change, never remove

application.name: Name
application.environmentNameHint: As the sessions name it, such as local or staging.
application.explorationHint: What the agent that explores the interface may do with the data of this environment.
application.idHint: Lower case letters and digits separated by hyphens.
application.accountsHint: The configuration keeps the names of the variables alone; type the credentials below, they stay on the computer the tool runs on.

knowledge.openapiHint: Either its address, or a file of the test repository.
knowledge.connectionStringEnvHint: The name the connection string is kept under; type it below, it stays on the computer the tool runs on.
knowledge.documentPathHint: In the test repository: a Markdown file, or a folder of them.
knowledge.storedNote: Its documents are kept by the instance, and uploaded to it once the configuration is saved.
knowledge.codePathHint: Relative to the test repository; it may lead outside, to another repository.
knowledge.commands: Commands the agents may run there
knowledge.logsHint: Either a log file, or a container and its engine.
knowledge.attachmentsHint: The applications whose sessions read this source, each narrowed to one of its environments and APIs if need be.
knowledge.checkFailed: The test could not be made: {{reason}}
knowledge.answered_zero: Connected, but the source holds nothing yet.
knowledge.unchecked: Logs are read while a session runs: they are not tested here.

screen.conflict: oqas.json changed since the last synchronisation
screen.conflictNote: Your changes would write over it. Nothing is merged: choose what is kept.
screen.fileChanged: oqas.json changed since the revision in force
screen.fileChangedNote: It is taken when the next session starts, or now.
screen.fileMissing: oqas.json is not in the test repository: the next save writes it.
screen.saved: Revision {{number}} saved: oqas.json is written again, and the next session reads it.
screen.valued: The values typed are saved on this computer.
screen.title: Configuration
screen.readingNote: It shows as soon as the instance answered.
screen.none: The instance has no configuration yet
screen.noneNote: Write oqas.json at the root of the test repository: the console takes it up.
screen.secrets: The values typed here — key, connection strings, passwords — stay on the computer the tool runs on, out of the test repository and of the database. An environment variable wins: that is the way of a CI.
screen.knowledgeNote: What the agents read about the applications. Each source names where it is read — never a secret — and the applications it belongs to.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.readingNote: It shows as soon as the instance answered.
knowledge.noneNote: Declare the contracts, the databases, the documents, the code and the logs the agents read in the configuration.
knowledge.lead: The sources of each application, and where each is read from. The domains the cartography maps them into come in a later version.
knowledge.noSource: No source is attached to this application
knowledge.unknownNote: The configuration in force declares none: it may have been renamed or removed.
knowledge.storedNote: Its documents are kept by the instance: a session writes them where its agents read them. Only Markdown is read.
knowledge.readThere: The agents read this source where it is: nothing is uploaded to it.
knowledge.documentsHint: in the order of their names
knowledge.confirmNote: The document is deleted from the instance, and the next sessions no longer read it. This cannot be undone.
knowledge.filesHint: {{size}} at most each, {{count}} at most at once. A document of the same name is replaced.
knowledge.uploaded_one: {{count}} document uploaded: the next sessions read it.
knowledge.uploaded_other: {{count}} documents uploaded: the next sessions read them.
knowledge.openingNote: It shows as soon as the instance answered.

mapping.noIndex: Nothing is mapped yet: each source added is mapped at once, then all of them are put together by domain.
mapping.index: Knowledge put together by domain on {{date}}.
mapping.partIndex: Knowledge put together by domain on {{date}}, in part: a limit stopped the cartography.

tests.title: Tests
tests.readingNote: They show as soon as the instance answered.
tests.noneNote: The tests of the test repository show here once a session of the agent wrote some, or a person added some.
tests.lead_one: {{count}} test of the test repository, as its file is now.
tests.lead_other: {{count}} tests of the test repository, as their files are now.
tests.search: Search a title, a path or a tag
tests.levelFilter: Levels of the pyramid of tests
tests.noMatchNote: Search other words, or choose another level.

test.readingNote: It shows as soon as the instance answered.
test.noCompare: The message of the failed assertion does not say what it received: the details tell it whole.
test.noStep: The run reported no step of this test.

summary.flaky_one: Passes its {{count}} step after a retry.
summary.flaky_other: Passes its {{count}} steps after a retry.

test.history: The latest executions, the oldest on the left
test.neverRunNote: Its executions show here as soon as a session of the agent, or an execution, ran it.
test.uncommittedNote: Only run before it was committed, as during a design.
test.unknown: This test is no longer in the repository
test.unknownNote: Its file was renamed or removed; its past executions stay listed here.

executions.title: Executions
executions.readingNote: They show as soon as the instance answered.
executions.noneNote: The executions of the tests show here once a session of the agent ran the tests it wrote.
executions.lead: The executions of the tests, the latest first.
executions.noMatchNote: No execution kept matches these filters.

execution.title: Execution of {{date}}
execution.readingNote: It shows as soon as the instance answers.
execution.noSession: The session that ran it is no longer kept.
execution.noVersion: Version of the test repository not kept.
execution.noTest: No test ran in this execution.
execution.manual: Launched by hand, with no agent.

result.gone: The detail of this execution is no longer available
result.goneNote: Its report was removed, or does not hold this test.

trace.title: Trace
trace.noneNote: This execution did not keep it: Playwright keeps the trace of a test as its configuration says, often only when it fails.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.lead: A campaign is made of the tests you choose, fixed once it is ready, then follows what came of each at every launch.
campaigns.readingNote: They show as soon as the instance answered.
campaigns.noneNote: Plan one: a name and an environment, then choose its tests.

campaign.readingNote: It shows as soon as the instance answered.
campaign.plannedNote: Choose its tests below: they may change until you fix them.
campaign.noTestNote: No test is chosen for this campaign.
campaign.launchPreparing: Launch being prepared: installing, then checking the addresses of the environment…
campaign.closeQuestion: Close it for good? A closed campaign is not launched again.
campaign.launching: The tests of the campaign run: the verdicts come at the end of the launch.

relaunch.finished: Test run, its result is coming…

campaignComposer.title: Tests of the campaign
campaignComposer.reading: Reading the tests of the repository
campaignComposer.readingNote: They show as soon as the instance answered.
campaignComposer.noneNote: The agents write some in the sessions of design.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.lead: Agents find out your application, propose the tests that matter and write them in Playwright in this folder. Three steps: your applications, what the agents may read, the model. Nothing is written before the last.

applications.title: Your applications
applications.lead: For each application: its name, what it exposes, and its address in each test environment, never in production.

knowledge.title: What the agents may read
knowledge.lead: An API contract, the code, a database or documents: what helps the agents understand the application. You may add more later.

model.title: The model
model.lead: The model the agents think with: test the connection, then choose it in the list.

summary.title: Summary
summary.lead: Here is what will be created. « Create the project » writes the configuration and prepares the Playwright project in this folder.
summary.github: Model: {{model}}, through the GitHub account of this machine
summary.newRepository: This folder will become a git repository, and what is created will be committed to it.
summary.existingRepository: This folder is a git repository already: what is created is left to you to commit.
summary.mapping: Each is mapped as soon as the project is created, then all of them are put together by domain.

ready.title: The project is ready
ready.committed: The configuration and the Playwright project are written and committed to a new git repository.
ready.toCommit: The configuration and the Playwright project are written: commit them to git before the first session.
